summary: TechPrecision Corporation filed a Form 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting that its subsidiary Ranor, Inc. and affiliated borrowers executed a Fifteenth Amendment to their Amended and Restated Loan Agreement with Beacon Bank Trust on September 15, 2026. The amendment extends the maturity date of the $4,500,000 revolving line of credit from September 15, 2026 to October 16, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, price, premium, or ownership change is stated; this is a routine credit-facility extension, not a special situation. Watch for further short-dated extensions or refinancing risk given the brief one-month maturity stagger.
